description: This file defines the 'Statistics' object providing various statistical functions in Spark's MLlib, including correlation, chi-squared tests, and Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests.

methods.name: colStats
methods.description: Computes column-wise summary statistics for an RDD of Vectors or weighted vectors.

methods.name: corr
methods.description: Computes the Pearson or Spearman correlation matrix for an RDD of Vectors.

methods.name: corr (x: RDD[Double], y: RDD[Double])
methods.description: Computes Pearson correlation between two RDDs of Doubles.

methods.name: corr (x: JavaRDD, y: JavaRDD)
methods.description: Java-friendly version of correlation between two RDDs.

methods.name: chiSqTest (observed: Vector, expected: Vector)
methods.description: Performs chi-squared goodness-of-fit test against an expected distribution.

methods.name: chiSqTest (observed: Vector)
methods.description: Performs chi-squared goodness-of-fit test against a uniform distribution.

methods.name: chiSqTest (observed: Matrix)
methods.description: Performs chi-squared test for independence on a contingency matrix.

methods.name: chiSqTest (data: RDD[LabeledPoint])
methods.description: Performs chi-squared tests for each feature against the label in a labeled dataset.

methods.name: kolmogorovSmirnovTest (data: RDD[Double], cdf: Double => Double)
methods.description: Performs KS test for data against a specified distribution.

methods.name: kolmogorovSmirnovTest (data: RDD[Double], distName: String, params: Double*)
methods.description: Performs KS test for data against a named distribution with parameters.
